{{Top|leg}}
The '''Port Shopping Arcade''' was located on the [[Bazaar Deck]] of the [[Luxury liner/Legends|luxury liner]] [[Kuari Princess/Legends|''Kuari Princess'']]. It consisted of eight shops, all specializing in selling clothing. One of the shops was [[N'vadin]], which sold formal wear for [[Humanoid/Legends|humanoids]].
